summary: Completed testing of FamFocus Hub mobile features - Mobile OAuth, Push Notifications, Tutorial endpoints. All 22 backend API tests passed. Fixed critical bug in get_current_user() that prevented Bearer token authentication. Frontend onboarding (WelcomeTutorial + PixieOnboarding) working correctly.

issues: WelcomeTutorial and PixieOnboarding both use z-[100], causing overlay conflicts. PixieOnboarding shows first and blocks WelcomeTutorial until dismissed.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: get_current_user() was not passing Authorization header to get_session_token(), causing Bearer token auth to fail
Mobile OAuth endpoints (GET /api/auth/google/mobile, POST /api/auth/mobile/callback) working correctly
Push notification device registration (POST /api/notifications/register-device, DELETE /api/notifications/unregister-device) working
Web push endpoints (GET /api/push/vapid-key, POST /api/push/subscribe, DELETE /api/push/unsubscribe) working
WelcomeTutorial component renders correctly with slide navigation
PixieOnboarding component renders correctly with Skip Tour option
seed_data_creation: Created test user with session for mobile features testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile features tested. Bearer token authentication now works via Authorization header. Tutorial endpoints return role-specific slides (parent vs child). PixieOnboarding shows before WelcomeTutorial due to same z-index.

bug_fix_applied.issue: Authorization header was not being passed to get_session_token(), causing Bearer token authentication to always fail
bug_fix_applied.fix: Added 'authorization = request.headers.get("Authorization")' and passed it to get_session_token(request, authorization)

web_push: GET /api/push/vapid-key - PASS (returns publicKey, no auth required)
auth: GET /api/auth/me (with Bearer token) - PASS (returns user data)
